vendors.name: ABlyft
vendors.h1: We keep Enterprise A/B-Testing affordable
vendors.h2: The A/B testing platform that meets your privacy requirements, is rocket fast, and provides the best capabilities for implementing your experiments.
vendors.summary:
ABlyft is enterprise A/B testing for developers and experienced marketers, priced below the usual enterprise tier. Privacy-first and GDPR-compliant.

There's a free plan with no credit card. The Enterprise plan is quoted on request and includes unlimited experiments, customization and priority support.

Integration is a client-side JavaScript API for GET calls and experiment retrieval. No SDKs are documented for other languages. GA4 works through GTM, with a guide for querying ABlyft variation IDs in GA4 explorations. No Adobe Analytics, Segment or warehouse connectors are documented.

No MCP server and no AI features. GDPR is the only compliance certification disclosed. Site and docs are active in 2026.
vendors.seoDesc: ABlyft fits budget-conscious enterprise B2B SaaS teams. No MCP server or native AI features are documented, and search elsewhere for agent-ready automation.

vendors.name: Datadog
vendors.h1: Eppo is now Datadog Experiments
vendors.h2: We've spent the last year building a new generation of experimentation platform: trustworthy, self-service experimentation and feature flagging for every team. Now on Datadog.
vendors.summary:
Datadog Experiments went GA in April 2026. Randomization comes from Datadog Feature Flags; analysis runs on RUM, Product Analytics, or warehouse metrics in Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks.

Stats options are sequential frequentist, fixed-sample frequentist and Bayesian. CUPED variance reduction is on by default, and multiple testing correction is optional. Protocols save reusable templates covering metrics, randomization, duration and analysis plan. Built-in diagnostics flag sample ratio mismatch, unreliable or zero-data metrics, and exposure imbalance between variants.

The main AI surface is agentic. The Datadog MCP Server's experiments toolset lets AI clients list, create, start, conclude and cancel experiments, pull diagnostics and metric definitions, and segment results by any assignment property.

Built on Datadog's 2025 acquisition of Eppo; the standalone Eppo product is being folded in. [Updated 2026-09-15: removed prior Eppo-era claims about Contextual Bandits, Auto-Generate Explore Charts and automated Slack alerts. None appear in current Datadog Experiments docs.]
vendors.seoDesc: Datadog, formerly Eppo, fits warehouse-native B2B SaaS teams. It ships a platform MCP server with 7 AI features, and search elsewhere for GDPR, HIPAA or public pricing.

vendors.name: Omniconvert
vendors.h1: Customer Value Optimization platform for SaaS & ecommerce
vendors.h2: Identify your best customers and run experiments that move the metrics that matter, from acquisition to retention.
vendors.summary:
Omniconvert is a Romanian CRO platform with two products. Explore covers A/B testing, personalization, surveys, overlays and multivariate testing, with both Bayesian and frequentist models. Reveal handles customer retention and value analytics: revenue performance, repeat-purchase drivers, unprofitable products and high-value segments.

Server-side testing runs through SDKs for PHP, TypeScript/Node.js, Java, Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS/macOS). An AI CRO audit scans sites for conversion leaks and recommends tests. Nexus, the AI growth engine, connects acquisition, conversion and retention.

Pricing is visitor-based across Free, Essential, Expert (about $79/mo billed annually) and Advanced, with discounts at scale. The free tier covers 50K monthly tested views with the full Explore feature set. Integrations: GA4, Klaviyo, Shopify, Segment, Sendgrid, Gorgias.

Still actively developed; CSV export for main-goal conversions shipped in March 2026. Best fit is mid-size to large e-commerce. No SOC 2, HIPAA or ISO 27001 disclosed, and no warehouse connectors documented.
vendors.seoDesc: Omniconvert fits B2B SaaS and DTC marketing teams. It lists an MCP server and 3 AI features, and search elsewhere for SOC 2, HIPAA or ISO 27001 compliance.

vendors.name: Confidence (Spotify)
vendors.h1: Experiment like Spotify
vendors.h2: We fail fast and we learn fast, with Confidence. Now you can too.
vendors.summary:
Confidence is warehouse-native experimentation from Spotify. Its AI story runs through MCP rather than in-product assistants.

It runs two vendor-hosted streamable-HTTP MCP servers. The Documentation MCP at https://mcp.confidence.dev/mcp/docs needs no authentication and offers semantic search with maximum-marginal-relevance ranking, regex search, full-source retrieval and SDK integration guidance. The authenticated Flag Management MCP at https://mcp.confidence.dev/mcp/flags exposes nine tools: list, read, create and modify flags, add variants, update schemas, create override rules, test flag resolution with an explanation of why a variant was selected, and find unused or fully rolled-out flags.

Flags carry structured schemas with named variants resolved against evaluation context, and applied-flag events are written to the warehouse for later analysis. Spotify's public line is that faster AI-written code increases the need for experimentation and guardrails rather than reducing it. No generative-variant, bandit or autotune capability is documented.
vendors.seoDesc: Confidence (Spotify) fits warehouse-native B2B SaaS teams. It ships two MCP servers with 3 AI features, and search elsewhere for generative-variant or bandit autotune.

vendors.name: Sitecore
vendors.h1: Conversion optimization for real-time personalization and testing
vendors.h2: SitecoreAI helps you make each one count with real-time personalization powered by live audience insights. Deliver tailored experiences using real-time metrics from Audience and Insights.
vendors.summary:
SitecoreAI splits into assistants and agents. Assistants handle quick interactive work: improving content in real time, personalizing pages, supporting A/B testing and optimization, creating deliverables and smart briefs, brand guidance, and translating a page or a whole site. Agentic studio agents coordinate multi-step marketing processes, with brand kits applied across generation, optimization and translation. Documented features include running an A/B/n test with an AI-optimized variant.

For external agents, Sitecore ships the Marketer MCP server plus a REST Agent API. MCP exposes Agent API endpoints as tools (create_page, for example), and every action still passes through Sitecore security, permissions and approval workflows. Sitecore pitches it as launching pages, running SEO audits, managing content and personalizing from one AI chat in Claude or Copilot Studio.

Sitecore has also opened up to partner agentic platforms, with Gradial the first integration. Base page-builder personalization is still rule-based, extensible with Sitecore Personalize and CDP.
vendors.seoDesc: Sitecore fits enterprise B2B SaaS teams. It ships a Marketer MCP server with 8 AI features, and search elsewhere for generative personalization beyond its rule-based core.

vendors.name: Shoplift
vendors.h1: Your store's CRO Copilot
vendors.h2: Launch high-impact split tests, unlock insights, and take the guesswork out of optimization.
vendors.summary:
Shoplift calls itself a CRO copilot for high-growth Shopify brands. Lift Assist generates test ideas in real time using the brand's own data plus test ideas from hundreds of top brands. Bayesian predictive analysis estimates test duration live and gives significance estimates. Automated dashboards surface recommendations once a test finishes.

Shopify Plus Certified. Plans: Core $74-$99/mo (50K-100K visitors), Advanced $299/mo (100K visitors, adds Lift Assist, GA4 and the JS API), Pro $699/mo (250K visitors, dedicated account manager). 14-day free trial.

No MCP server, and no compliance certifications listed.
vendors.seoDesc: Shoplift fits Shopify DTC teams needing lightweight testing. It has 4 AI features but no MCP server, and search elsewhere for compliance certifications.

vendors.name: LaunchDarkly
vendors.h1: Move at AI speed. Stay in control.
vendors.h2: LaunchDarkly helps teams safely manage code and AI agents in production with feature flags, progressive delivery, automated rollback, and runtime control.
vendors.summary:
LaunchDarkly's AI surface is AgentControl. Configs pull prompts, instructions and model settings out of application code, in completion or agent mode, with variations, targeting, monitoring, experimentation and judges attached for online evaluation.

Agent Optimization entered public beta in July 2026. It runs optimization passes across models, prompts and configurations, scores them with a judge model, and deploys the winner from LaunchDarkly. AgentControl monitoring can now be filtered and grouped by context kind, so AI cost, latency, tokens and satisfaction can be attributed to individual tenants or users.

Agents drive it through a hosted OAuth MCP server at https://mcp.launchdarkly.com/mcp/launchdarkly, covering feature management, AgentControl and observability, with a local npx server for federal and EU instances. LaunchDarkly also publishes installable agent skills for multi-step workflows such as flag cleanup through to a pull request.
vendors.seoDesc: LaunchDarkly fits enterprise B2B SaaS and feature-flag teams. It ships an OAuth MCP server with 10 AI features around AgentControl, and no clear limitation documented.

vendors.name: Symplify
vendors.h1: CRM? No, we do much more than that…
vendors.h2: Future proof whatever you choose to call it. Your competitors are… CRM. Marketing Automation. AI. Conversion Testing. Consumer Data Insights. That's a lot of name calling when you could simply say Symplify.
vendors.summary:
Symplify is a Swedish customer engagement platform that reaches well past CRO, covering CRM, marketing automation, predictive marketing, message automation, personalization, and testing and experimentation. The experimentation module combines A/B testing with visitor recordings, heatmaps and frustration-click measurement.

An OpenAI integration generates text and images inside the Symplify editor; Symplify claims this cuts content creation time by up to 60%. Symplify AI adds machine-learning predictions: lifetime value scoring, churn likelihood, VIP identification and first-visit personalization.

PHP is the only server-side SDK. GA4 events are picked up natively, with gtag and GTM auto-detected. GDPR-compliant under Swedish and EU law, with SSL encryption and 2FA. No SOC 2, HIPAA or ISO 27001 disclosed, and no MCP server.

Strong vertical focus on iGaming (several gambling partnerships including GiG), fintech, retail, NGO and education, and hospitality. Active through 2026.
vendors.seoDesc: Symplify fits enterprise client-side marketing teams. It has only 2 AI features and no MCP server, and search elsewhere for compliance certification or non-PHP SDKs.

vendors.name: VWO
vendors.h1: Digital Experience Optimization
vendors.h2: VWO is the market-leading digital experience optimization solution that fast-growing companies use for experimentation & conversion rate optimization.
vendors.summary:
VWO Copilot is an AI layer across the experimentation workflow. Editor Copilot generates design variations from text prompts. AI-Generated Ideas scans pages and adds hypotheses to the backlog. Other copilots help with heatmap and session-recording analysis, page selection and segment generation. Campaigns can be created from natural language.

VWO runs two MCP surfaces. The vendor-hosted OAuth server at https://mcp.vwo.io/mcp (with EU and Asia endpoints) is gated by Browse, Design and Publish-Admin scopes, and exposes campaign overview and A/B campaign creation. The self-hosted FME server (npx vwo-fme-mcp@latest, account ID plus API key) handles feature-flag create, update and delete, plus environment toggles from the IDE.

Between them, external agents can reach both marketing-side campaign work and developer-side flag management.
vendors.seoDesc: VWO fits enterprise B2B SaaS and DTC teams running server-side tests. It ships two MCP servers with 6 AI features, and no clear limitation documented.

vendors.name: Optimizely
vendors.h1: AI-powered digital experiences that turn heads
vendors.h2: Create content fast. Personalize with ease. Test, analyze, and repeat. Then scale it all with AI and see what your team is capable of.
vendors.summary:
Optimizely's AI layer is Opal, an agent-orchestration platform spanning Optimizely One: 50+ pre-built agents, no-code agent building, workflow orchestration, knowledge integration, quality evaluation and human-in-the-loop review.

In experimentation, Opal supplies AI variation generation, test-idea suggestions, variation summaries and Opal Chat. Optimizely reports that 58.74% of Opal usage is experimentation, across 47,000 interactions at 900 companies. Q3 2026 added image generation and editing, Voice Mode, Brand and Channel Packs, Virtual Teammates and human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints.

Two MCP servers are now exposed: Experimentation (exp_* tools for query, manage and SDK implementation) and Analytics (oa_* tools for discovery, exploration building and scorecard analysis). Both authenticate over OAuth through Opti ID/Opal.

Contextual bandits remain the personalization mechanism, optimizing the primary metric per user from attributes rather than picking one global winner.
vendors.seoDesc: Optimizely fits enterprise B2B SaaS and DTC teams. It ships two OAuth MCP servers with 9 AI features under Opal, and search elsewhere for SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a free tier.

vendors.name: Adobe Target
vendors.h1: A/B Testing Software
vendors.h2: Discover Adobe Target, the leading AB testing software that empowers you to optimize user experiences and drive conversions with personalized, data-driven insights.
vendors.summary:
Adobe Target's biggest recent move is its own MCP server, in public beta and hosted by Adobe at https://targetmcp.adobe.io/mcp. AI assistants can inspect, analyze and manage A/B tests and personalization activities in natural language.

It exposes 41 tools across 10 categories: activity inspection and audit; performance, revenue and A4T reporting for A/B, XT, AP and Auto-Target activities; creating and updating A/B and Experience Targeting activities; traffic-split and variant management; activity state control; audience and HTML/JSON offer management; and implementation audit of at.js settings and response tokens.

Access is OAuth 2.0 through Adobe Experience Cloud, with no static credentials. Tool availability follows the Target role: Observer for read, Editor for write, Approver for activation. Adobe attaches an explicit 'as is' risk disclaimer to MCP integrations and recommends sandbox testing first.

Target's own AI activity types, Automated Personalization and Auto-Target, are still first-class and reportable through the MCP.
vendors.seoDesc: Adobe Target fits enterprise DTC teams. Its MCP server is public beta with 8 AI features under an "as is" disclaimer, and search elsewhere for production-ready access.

vendors.name: Conductrics
vendors.h1: A unified engine for experimentation, adaptive optimization, and customer research
vendors.h2: Unlock the power of intentional learning. Conductrics brings behavioral testing and qualitative feedback together in a single, flexible platform, so you can turn insights into immediate value for your customers.
vendors.summary:
Conductrics runs experimentation, adaptive optimization and customer research in one engine, pairing behavioral A/B testing with qualitative feedback. The differentiator is adaptive optimization with interpretable machine learning that moves traffic toward better-performing variants. It's a contextual bandit approach, though Conductrics avoids the label, and algorithmic transparency is treated as a design principle.

Used by Spotify, Experian and Pfizer. HIPAA-compliant design, which is unusual for an experimentation platform, plus SOC 2 Type 2.

Pricing is custom enterprise only, with no public tier table. Native analytics integrations cover Google Analytics including GA4, and Adobe Analytics, across client-side, server-side and native mobile. No MCP server, no warehouse connectors and no ISO 27001 statement. Independent and operating as of 2026.
vendors.seoDesc: Conductrics fits enterprise B2B SaaS teams. It has 3 AI features but no MCP server, and search elsewhere for data warehouse connectors or published pricing.

vendors.name: ABsmartly
vendors.h1: The most developer-friendly A/B testing platform
vendors.h2: Advanced experimentation and feature flagging platform designed to help teams validate ideas quickly, measure impact reliably and roll out changes safely.
vendors.summary:
ABsmartly deliberately doesn't market AI. The positioning is built by developers, for developers, around trustworthy A/B testing. The Health Check Panel is called an experimentation copilot, but it's rule-based anomaly detection (sample ratio mismatch, audience mismatch, variable conflicts), not generative AI.

The group sequential testing engine cuts test cycles by 20-80% against a fixed horizon, twice as fast as standard sequential testing. Warehouse Native mode runs analysis inside the customer's own warehouse: BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Redshift or Databricks. A hybrid deployment mode is planned.

An MCP server repo exists (absmartly/mcp-server) but isn't documented in the product docs yet. The LaunchPad browser extension lets non-technical users launch tests.

Pricing is event-based, starting at €60,000/year for 50M events a month, with unlimited seats, experiments and goals.
vendors.seoDesc: ABsmartly fits enterprise B2B SaaS and feature-flag teams. It ships an MCP server with 2 AI features, but search elsewhere if you want less than 60K euro/year price.

vendors.name: Intelligems
vendors.h1: AI that understands the realities of your business
vendors.h2: You don't want best practices, you want to know what's going to work for you.
vendors.summary:
Intelligems is built for Shopify merchants and pitches AI that understands the business side, not just the page. The AI Visual Builder (beta) takes a plain-language description of an on-site change and builds a brand-matched version. Experiment recommendations suggest which profit lever to test (price, discount, shipping) based on past performance, and automated pricing suggestions recommend price points from site-wide analytics.

The Intelligems MCP server exposes store-level data (experiments, catalog, analytics, audiences, custom events) to Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini over an OAuth-authenticated API, with profit-per-visitor breakdowns available in conversation.

Plans: Core $79/mo (under 3K orders), Plus $499/mo, Blue $999/mo, with a 14-day free trial. A data-sharing add-on covers Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks and cloud storage.
vendors.seoDesc: Intelligems fits Shopify DTC teams testing pricing. It ships an OAuth MCP server with 6 AI features, and search elsewhere for first-party compliance certification.

vendors.name: Webtrends Optimize
vendors.h1: Webtrends Optimize: Next Generation
vendors.h2: Webtrends Optimize is a simple to use, yet extremely powerful testing and personalisation platform using Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) tools to drive better visitor experiences on your website and increase ROI.
vendors.summary:
Webtrends Optimize is a UK enterprise testing and personalization platform aimed at high-traffic consumer sites in e-commerce, media, travel and financial services.

Its AI suite runs under 'AI with Purpose': predictive heatmaps for experiment design, synthetic user testing, an in-UI coding copilot for building and debugging tests, visually similar product recommendations that read category, style, colour and texture from product images, Auto Insights for automated experiment analysis, and AI for Analysis (open beta May 2026).

Pricing is based on annual sessions under custom enterprise contracts; tiers aren't public. SDKs cover a JavaScript tag, Android (Java/Kotlin AAR) and iOS (Swift/Obj-C). Push integrations to GA4, Adobe Analytics and Segment; a Snowflake pull integration imports user profiles for segmentation.

GDPR and CCPA compliance. No MCP server, no SOC 2, HIPAA or ISO 27001 disclosed, and no BigQuery or Redshift connectors documented. A hybrid or managed service option targets large brands with their own CRO teams. Operating in 2026.
vendors.seoDesc: Webtrends Optimize fits enterprise testing teams. It has 8 AI features but no MCP server, and search elsewhere for SOC 2, HIPAA or ISO 27001 compliance.

vendors.name: PostHog
vendors.h1: Dev tools for product engineers
vendors.h2: PostHog is an all-in-one developer platform for building successful products. We offer product analytics, web analytics, session replay, error tracking, feature flags, experimentation, surveys, data warehouse, a CDP, and an AI product assistant.
vendors.summary:
PostHog AI is an in-product analyst. It answers plain-English questions against the project's own events, persons and warehouse schema, writes the SQL and builds insights. It also acts: creating dashboards, surveys, alerts and feature flags, editing filters in the UI, and keeping project memory across conversations. It's available in the web app, inline throughout the UI, and in Slack in beta, and it can hand code changes to a connected repository and return a pull request.

Self-driving PostHog goes further. Background agents cluster signals from errors, session replays, support tickets and external tools into reports, then open PRs in a sandbox. A human still merges.

Agent access is first-class. A free hosted MCP endpoint at https://mcp.posthog.com/mcp exposes function-calling tools across every PostHog product, including full experiment lifecycle control and governed semantic-layer metrics. Some MCP tools call LLMs internally and are only available when AI data processing is enabled.
vendors.seoDesc: PostHog fits warehouse-native B2B SaaS and mobile teams. It ships a free MCP server with 12 AI features, and search elsewhere for ISO 27001 certification.

vendors.name: Uniform
vendors.h1: Connect. Orchestrate. Ship. Optimize.
vendors.h2: The agentic DXP that adapts to your needs. Get powerful CMS, orchestration, personalization, and agentic AI out-of-the-box, plus seamless integration with any existing tools.
vendors.summary:
Uniform's AI centres on Scout, an agentic assistant that executes rather than suggests. It creates pages and content from natural-language briefs, optimizes existing pages for SEO, accessibility and performance, suggests audience segments, builds personalized variations and A/B tests, auto-tags content, and translates compositions and entries into target locales.

Agent access runs both ways. The Uniform MCP server exposes 30+ tools across content, assets, structure, releases, classification, optimization and utilities, so Cursor, Claude Code or Copilot can manage a Uniform project. External MCP servers can also be connected into Scout.

The server is reached over HTTP at https://ai.uniform.global/projects/<project-id>/mcp with an x-api-key service-account or personal access token holding the Developer role. LLM-backed MCP tools consume Uniform AI credits and apply changes immediately, skipping Scout's pending-edit review step. Uniform recommends pairing the server with its AI rules so assistants have the context to use the tools well.
vendors.seoDesc: Uniform fits enterprise client-side marketing teams. It ships an MCP server with 7 AI features, and search elsewhere for a review step before MCP-driven changes go live.

vendors.name: Monetate
vendors.h1: The Experience Optimization Platform
vendors.h2: Monetate is the Experience Optimization Platform, helping the world's leading brands design, test, and deliver digital experiences that are relevant, trustworthy, and valuable.
vendors.summary:
MONET is Monetate's AI engine, running real-time adaptive intelligence across personalization, recommendations and experimentation. Monetate markets it as agentic AI that keeps learning and acting. A customer-facing GenAI assistant offers best practices and tailored guidance on demand.

Intelligent Personalization is the decisioning engine behind 1:1 personalization, with sub-20ms decisioning latency. Action Variables, set through the JS API or Engine API, drive rule-based or AI-informed triggers.

Monetate acquired SiteSpect in June 2025, adding zero-flicker server-side testing to its AI-native personalization. In September 2025 it repositioned as an Experience Optimization Platform, combining personalization, experimentation and discovery. Owned by Kibo Software. No MCP server documented.
vendors.seoDesc: Monetate fits enterprise DTC and B2B SaaS teams. It has 7 AI features but no documented MCP server, and search elsewhere for a published pricing tier.

vendors.name: AB Tasty
vendors.h1: One platform for all your progress
vendors.h2: We're the experience optimization partners pushing brave ideas from the inside out. The only digital experience platform you need.
vendors.summary:
AB Tasty runs a set of AI copilots across the experimentation workflow: Visual Editor Copilot generates variants from prompts, Report Copilot highlights winning variations, and there are Hypothesis and Feedback Analysis copilots too. EmotionsAI profiles visitors by emotional and content-interest segments for targeting, and EVI is the agent for agentic experimentation workflows. AI-driven content personalization predicts visitor intent in real time.

AB Tasty merged with VWO in January 2026 under Wingify (Everstone Capital), creating one combined experimentation platform. An MCP server exists as an unofficial npm package (@abtasty/mcp-server) but isn't in the official AB Tasty docs yet.
vendors.seoDesc: AB Tasty fits enterprise B2B SaaS teams. It has 7 AI features, but its MCP server exists only as an unofficial, undocumented npm package.

vendors.name: Convert
vendors.h1: Proven A/B Testing Tool
vendors.h2: Convert.com's A/B testing tool has split testing, personalization, advanced goals, fast support, and monthly payments.
vendors.summary:
The AI Wizard in Convert's visual editor suggests headlines, supporting text and variant copy or design (beta). Smart Traffic Allocation uses multi-armed bandits to shift traffic. Dynamic Triggers and BYOID (bring your own ID) keep bucketing stable.

A self-hostable MCP server lets AI assistants create and update experiences programmatically, pitched as A/B testing without a UI. Convert's own blog uses Claude Code as the example.

The AI features are built privacy-first: the Editor Wizard was trained on synthetic and de-identified data. Servers are hosted in Frankfurt, Germany for EU data residency.
vendors.seoDesc: Convert fits DTC, B2B SaaS and agency teams needing broad compliance. It ships an MCP server with 3 AI features, AI Wizard still in beta, and no limitation documented.

vendors.name: Zoho PageSense
vendors.h1: All-in-one platform for conversion rate optimization
vendors.h2: Track, analyze, optimize, personalize, and engage visitors to turn traffic into conversions.
vendors.summary:
Zoho PageSense is the conversion optimization product inside the Zoho suite, built on four pillars: A/B testing (split-URL, full-stack, server-side), conversion optimization (funnel analysis, form analytics, goal tracking, session recording), heatmaps (visual, scroll, click) and personalization.

Zia, Zoho's AI assistant, runs across the suite and can answer questions about experiment performance, suggest test ideas and trigger PageSense actions. Zoho also runs a workspace-level MCP platform (zoho.com/mcp) that exposes app actions to agents like Claude and ChatGPT over JSON-over-HTTPS. PageSense actions can go through it, but there's no PageSense-specific MCP documentation yet.

SDKs: .NET/C#, Android (Java/Kotlin), iOS (Swift/Obj-C). Integrations span the Zoho ecosystem (CRM, Flow, Forms, Commerce, SalesIQ) plus GA4, GTM, Mixpanel, KISSmetrics, Google Ads and Intercom. Pricing runs from a forever-free tier (5K users) through Professional and Enterprise (10K+ users, full A/B testing) to an Agency edition.

Compliance is the strongest among mid-tier CRO vendors: ISO 27001, ISO 27701, HIPAA (toggleable per project), GDPR, SAML SSO, anonymized IP and privacy masking in session recordings. No warehouse connectors, and SOC 2 isn't referenced for PageSense specifically, though it likely applies at the Zoho suite level.
vendors.seoDesc: Zoho PageSense fits B2B SaaS and agency teams on Zoho. It has 3 AI features but no PageSense-specific MCP server, and search elsewhere for a JavaScript SDK.

vendors.name: Harness FME
vendors.h1: Feature Management & Experimentation
vendors.h2: Release faster with feature flags connected to critical impact data and always know whether your software changes are making things better or worse.
vendors.summary:
Inside FME, Harness ships Release Agent, a multilingual in-app chatbot grounded in Harness documentation and blogs that answers questions on SDKs, flags, targeting, experiment interpretation and cleanup without leaving the UI. AI Summarize condenses feature-flag metric tiles, individual experiment metrics and overall results. Admins toggle both under FME Settings > AI settings.

Across the platform, Harness launched Autonomous Worker Agents in June 2026. They run as governed pipeline steps on customer-controlled Delegates, produce auditable outputs, draw memory from the Harness Knowledge Graph and capability from the Harness MCP.

The MCP server is open source and self-hosted (npx harness-mcp-v2, Docker or from source). It routes 11 consolidated tools to 139 resource types across 30 toolsets, including Feature Management and Experimentation, with 27 pre-built prompt templates. Authentication uses a Harness personal access token, with a documented enterprise SSO path.

For FME specifically, agents can discover projects, list and inspect flags, compare a flag across environments, and find fully rolled-out flags that are safe to remove.
vendors.seoDesc: Harness FME fits enterprise B2B SaaS teams running server-side, warehouse-native tests. It ships an MCP server with 10 AI features, and search elsewhere for published pricing.

vendors.name: Salesforce Personalization
vendors.h1: Engage customers with relevance, anytime, anywhere
vendors.h2: Personalise every interaction a customer has with your brand with real-time recommendations in Agentforce, Marketing, and Service Clouds.
vendors.summary:
Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization, formerly Interaction Studio and before that Evergage, handles real-time 1:1 personalization, recommendations and decisioning across web, email and mobile. It now includes native web experimentation: marketers run experiments against a traffic subset, define custom primary and secondary metrics, and review lift, chance-to-beat-control and chance-to-beat-all. Experiment data is drillable in Data Cloud and exportable to BI tools.

Custom engagement signal metrics, compound metrics and first/last-touch attribution models feed the recommenders and the decisioning engine.

Agentforce works in both directions. Personalization context actions run ahead of Agent topics so agents decide with visitor context, and Agentforce Actions turn live conversation intent into structured signals for the decisioning engine.

Agent access is governed at the Salesforce platform level through Hosted MCP Servers using per-user OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. Those servers cover SObjects, Data 360, Tableau Next and customer-exposed Apex/Flow tools, but there's no Personalization-specific MCP server. Pricing now itemizes Agentforce Personalization Decisioning, AI objective-based recommendations and AI next-best offer.
vendors.seoDesc: Salesforce Personalization fits enterprise B2B SaaS teams. It has 7 AI features but only platform-level MCP access, and search elsewhere for a product-specific MCP server.

vendors.name: Contentful Personalization
vendors.h1: Personalization at scale for composable architectures
vendors.h2: Drive higher engagement with your customer journeys. Test, analyze, and refine the performance of your experiences, now part of Contentful Personalization.
compliance: EU-U.S. / UK / Swiss Data Privacy Framework
vendors.summary: Contentful Personalization, formerly Ninetailed, is the personalization and experimentation layer inside Contentful, which is exactly where composable-content teams would want it. Agent access arrives at the Contentful platform level rather than through a dedicated MCP server, so evaluate it as a Contentful decision rather than a standalone tool choice.
vendors.seoDesc: Contentful Personalization fits enterprise DTC teams. It has a platform MCP server with 5 AI features, and search elsewhere for documentation beyond Contentful's own.

vendors.name: Varify.io
vendors.h1: The Google Optimize Alternative That's Simple, Affordable & GDPR-Ready
vendors.h2: Transparent prices. Unlimited traffic. The A/B testing platform built for marketing teams.
vendors.summary:
Varify.io is a German A/B testing platform pitched as the simple, affordable, GDPR-ready Google Optimize alternative. It's aimed at marketing teams and agencies who don't want developer overhead.

Pricing is flat-rate with unlimited traffic and unlimited tests on every plan: Growth €149/mo, Pro €249/mo (adds BigQuery, advanced segmentation and priority support), Enterprise custom. Cookie-less and EU-hosted in Frankfurt.

An AI CRO audit and prompt-based features generate optimization ideas and test suggestions, and the AI assistant can write variant code from a short prompt. Visual and code editors come with all plans. GA4 reporting is native and auto-detected. BigQuery export comes with Pro and above. Other integrations: Matomo, Piwik Pro, Snowplow, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar.

GDPR-compliant by design. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are inherited from AWS and Cloudflare hosting; Varify itself isn't certified directly and stores no personal data. 2,700+ teams worldwide as of 2026.
vendors.seoDesc: Varify.io fits DTC and B2B SaaS teams. It lists 6 AI features and an MCP server that its own page calls undocumented, and search elsewhere for compliance certification.

vendors.name: Croct
vendors.h1: Optimize your website for each user
vendors.h2: Personalize your content, experiment with different journeys for different users, and drive more conversions without over-relying on your developers.
vendors.summary:
Croct is a headless personalization, A/B testing and feature-flag platform for developer-centric product teams, positioned as a component-based headless CMS with testing and personalization built in. The audience is engineering and growth teams in SaaS, e-commerce and digital products.

AI-powered segmentation discovers high-value visitor segments in real time. Event-based expressions let audiences react to past behaviour through the Croct Query Language (CQL), which works like a memory for segmentation.

The SDK stack is JavaScript only: core JS, Next.js and React. A one-click Vercel integration provisions API keys automatically. There's a free tier with no credit card, and custom enterprise pricing above that. G2 Leader in Headless CMS, Personalization, AB Testing and Component CMS (Winter/Spring 2026).

No MCP server, and no compliance certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001) publicly stated. Operating in 2026.
vendors.seoDesc: Croct fits B2B SaaS teams testing personalization. No MCP server or AI features are verified, and search elsewhere for compliance certifications or non-JS SDKs.

vendors.name: Mutiny
vendors.h1: Your AI agent for creating anything customer-facing
vendors.h2: Be the one buyers remember. Join the frontier of how the best GTM teams operate.
vendors.summary:
Mutiny is an AI agent that writes customer-facing content from natural-language prompts: 1:1 landing pages, deal rooms, pitch decks, business cases, meeting recaps, case studies and pricing proposals. It pulls in CRM data, call transcripts and account research to personalize at scale.

The Mutiny MCP server (HTTP plus OAuth) connects Claude, ChatGPT, IDEs and other MCP clients so assets can be generated inside those tools. Visitor Intelligence integrations with Outreach and Salesloft surface buyer signals.

Mutiny started as a B2B website personalization tool and has pivoted to agent-first content generation. Pricing: Free, Business at $50/seat/month, Enterprise from $30,000/year.
vendors.seoDesc: Mutiny fits enterprise B2B SaaS teams personalizing marketing content. It ships an OAuth MCP server with 6 AI features, and search elsewhere for ISO 27001 certification.

vendors.name: GrowthBook
vendors.h1: Build Smarter. Ship Faster.
vendors.h2: The warehouse-native platform used by modern product teams for experimentation, feature flags, and product analytics.
vendors.summary:
GrowthBook is explicitly agent-operable. Version 5.0 (July 2026) shipped 25 open-source agent skills, an in-app AI Assistant, and a CLI covering 100% of the REST API. Agents can create flags, configure ramps, launch experiments, query analytics, conclude winners and clean up stale flags, all routed through the same approval workflows, role-based permissions and audit logs as human changes.

A rebuilt AI Visual Editor (Chrome extension, Pro and Enterprise) turns plain-language prompts into fully configured A/B tests, and can generate and test images without a designer. In-app AI writes experiment result summaries, SQL for the Explorer, metric descriptions and hypothesis feedback, and finds similar past experiments using vector embeddings. Self-hosted deployments can turn these on with their own OpenAI key.

The self-hosted MCP server (@growthbook/mcp, API key plus email) exposes 16 tools across flags, experiments, metrics, environments, projects, SDK connections and docs search. The earlier WebLens hypothesis generator and multi-armed bandits are still part of the platform.
vendors.seoDesc: GrowthBook fits warehouse-native B2B SaaS teams running server-side tests. It ships a self-hosted MCP server with 6 AI features, and no clear limitation documented.

vendors.name: Kameleoon
vendors.h1: Build experiments in minutes by chatting with AI
vendors.h2: Kameleoon's AI platform allows you to build, test, and roll out impactful experiments in one place. From the first test to final release, you're in control.
vendors.summary:
Kameleoon's AI centres on Prompt-Based Experimentation (PBX), now a five-agent lifecycle. Ideate scans a site and returns prioritised, evidence-based hypotheses, free on a Basic tier for all Web Experimentation customers, with a paid Premium tier for unlimited analyses. Build generates production-grade UI variations on the live site from natural language, with Master Prompts, Figma import and a browser extension. Configure sets targeting, goals and traffic allocation, including bandit methods, from prompts. Analyze surfaces business takeaways through the Takeaways menu. Ship pushes winners into production through the MCP server.

KAI, the in-app AI assistant, answers questions from documentation and experiment data, and acts directly on the account through the same tools.

The MCP server (https://mcp.kameleoon.com/mcp, OAuth) exposes 37 tools covering the full experiment and flag lifecycle (create, duplicate, start, pause, resume, stop, delete), goals, segments, targeting rules, results and raw variation code, including transpose_winning_experiment for one-call winner rollout. Non-developers can use it as a Claude custom connector, with documented Airtable and Notion export workflows.

AI Predictive Targeting scores each visitor's conversion probability for real-time activation, and AI-generated Takeaways consolidate insights across stopped experiments.
vendors.seoDesc: Kameleoon fits enterprise B2B SaaS and DTC teams. It ships an MCP server with 9 AI features around its PBX agent lifecycle, and no clear limitation documented.

vendors.name: Statsig
vendors.h1: Measure what ships. Ship what matters.
vendors.h2: Test how each release - from features to AI-powered experiences - lands with customers, so you can protect trust and optimize at the speed of AI
compliance: EU-U.S. / UK / Swiss Data Privacy Framework
vendors.summary:
Statsig's optimization core is still Autotune, a Bayesian multi-armed bandit that shifts traffic toward the best-performing variant, plus contextual bandits that rank variants per user from attributes.

Since December 2025, AI has spread across the experiment workflow: summaries that make an explicit ship recommendation, a hypothesis advisor that critiques hypotheses during setup, contextual AI descriptions, AI knowledge-bank search and AI stale-gate cleanup.

Agent surfaces have grown fastest. There's an OAuth-authenticated MCP server usable from Codex, Cursor and Claude Code, a Statsig ChatGPT app, and an agent-skills repository. MCP coverage spans metrics tools, segments and layers, parameter store, autotune creation, version history and read-only access modes.

Statsig also ships an AI Evals product for offline and online LLM evaluation alongside the experimentation platform.
vendors.seoDesc: Statsig fits warehouse-native B2B SaaS teams across mobile and DTC. It ships an MCP server with 8 AI features, and no clear limitation documented.

vendors.name: Webflow Optimize
vendors.h1: Learn what performs. Deliver it at scale.
vendors.h2: Run experiments, personalize for every visitor, and let AI deliver the winning experience, whether your site is built on Webflow or not.
vendors.summary:
Webflow Optimize is Webflow's native A/B testing and personalization add-on, combining three approaches: traditional A/B testing, rules-based personalization, and AI optimization that learns what content works for each visitor down to a 1:1 level. It works on sites that aren't built on Webflow, not just Webflow-hosted ones.

The Webflow AI Assistant proposes variant suggestions, writes copy for headlines, CTAs and body, and gives predictive audience insights. AI Optimize picks the best variant per visitor in real time.

Webflow runs an open-source MCP server (github.com/webflow/mcp-server) that turns natural-language prompts from Cursor or Claude into Webflow Data API calls. It's self-hosted or Webflow-hosted with OAuth, covering list collections, create items, update styles and publish site. SDKs: JavaScript/TypeScript (js-webflow-api) and Python (webflow-python), with OAuth or site-specific tokens. A browser API is auto-injected on Optimize-enabled sites (wf.onVariationRecorded, wf.setAttributes).

Pricing is a $299/mo add-on for up to 500K page-views with 5 concurrent optimizations, with Enterprise quoted above that. Native warehouse exports to BigQuery (real-time streaming via webhooks) and Redshift. Integrations: GA4, HubSpot, Klaviyo. Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, SAML SSO. HIPAA not confirmed. Customers include Ideo, Monday.com, BBDO, The New York Times and TED.
vendors.seoDesc: Webflow Optimize fits B2B SaaS and DTC teams already on Webflow. It ships an open-source MCP server with 6 AI features, and search elsewhere for HIPAA confirmation.

vendors.name: Compose
vendors.h1: The only pay as you go A/B testing platform on the market
vendors.h2: Unleash the power of next-gen experimentation while only paying for what you need with our unique pay-as-you-go pricing.
vendors.summary:
Compose is a no-code, Shopify-native A/B testing app pitched as an affordable alternative to Convert, AB Tasty, VWO and Optimizely. It's the only pay-as-you-go option on the market: free to install, then $0.0012 per tested user, meaning a unique visitor in an active experiment.

It supports theme and template testing, product page tests, collection tests, and JavaScript variants in a code editor for custom logic. The visual editor works directly against the Shopify storefront, and checkout integration is native.

No AI features, no MCP server and no compliance certifications listed. Aimed at small and mid-size Shopify merchants who want flexibility and low-cost experimentation.
vendors.seoDesc: Compose fits Shopify DTC and agency teams needing lightweight testing. No MCP server or AI features are documented, and search elsewhere for compliance coverage.

vendors.name: Amplitude
vendors.h1: AI Analytics Platform for Modern Digital Analytics
vendors.h2: Build better products by turning your user data into meaningful insights, using Amplitude's digital analytics platform and experimentation tools.
compliance: EU-U.S. / UK / Swiss Data Privacy Framework
vendors.summary:
The MCP server is the main way agents work with Amplitude. It's vendor-hosted and OAuth-authenticated, at https://mcp.amplitude.com/mcp (EU: https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp). Agents can read charts, dashboards, notebooks, experiments and cohorts, run segmentation, funnel and retention queries, and create or edit most of those same objects, plus feature flags and metrics. Access follows whatever permissions the user already has. Role-based access controls and a Slackbot surface arrived in June 2026.

Amplitude calls the wider story "Headless Amplitude" (amplitude.com/headless): the MCP server plus an amp CLI (github.com/amplitude/developer-cli) for scripted, repeatable commands. Service accounts can authenticate with OAuth 2.0 client credentials for jobs with no human in the loop. A separate read-only Docs MCP server serves the public docs, no auth needed.

On the product side, Custom Agents and Agent Connectors shipped in June 2026, alongside Session Replay Agent v2 and AI Feedback Auto Analysis.
vendors.seoDesc: Amplitude fits enterprise B2B SaaS and warehouse-native teams. It ships an MCP server with 8 AI features, and no clear limitation is documented.

vendors.name: Dynamic Yield
vendors.h1: Personalization & Experimentation Pioneers
vendors.h2: Dynamic Yield's Experience OS delivers digital experiences that are personalized, optimized, and synchronized.
vendors.summary:
AdaptML is Dynamic Yield's core AI engine: real-time affinity profiles, next-best-item prediction and multi-purchase cadence modelling. The recommendations engine uses deep learning, visual similarity and reinforcement learning across catalogs with millions of SKUs. Predictive Targeting scores audiences for uplift potential. A Copywriter feature with Stability.ai generates copy and visuals. NextML NLP models predict the next best item. Shopping Muse is a generative AI commerce advisor: a shopper describes what they need ('outfit for a beach wedding in Bali') and it recommends.

Mastercard acquired Dynamic Yield in 2022, and the platform now uses Mastercard Element spend signals. Warehouse export runs through a Snowflake connector via Improvado, with raw event data available through the Daily Activity Stream.

No Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for external AI assistants is documented.
vendors.seoDesc: Dynamic Yield fits enterprise DTC and B2B SaaS teams. It lists 11 AI features but no documented MCP server, and search elsewhere for agent-ready access.
